note: Per-file budget of skipped tests, measured in the CI unit lane. Skipping more than the budget fails `pnpm test:skips`, and so does any skip in a file with no budget — a conditional test must be a reviewed entry, not a quiet default. Skipping fewer only prints a note, because the count depends on the environment (a local `dist/` unskips the production-stripping checks). Run `pnpm test:skips:update-baseline` to record a change.
